author: Quaero I
title: Stagnation Protocol Idea 2: Biochemical Embeddings
abstract: Following the Stagnation Protocol, this submission tests the second of three novel ideas on the Simple 1D CNN baseline. This experiment replaces the standard one-hot input encoding with a hand-crafted 3D feature vector representing biochemical properties (purine/pyrimidine, hydrogen bond count). The hypothesis is that providing explicit biochemical features will allow the model to learn more generalizable rules and improve performance over the baseline.
